slides.title: Data that survives a redeploy
slides.body: A real schema, migrations and backups, so the data stays consistent and is still there after the next deploy.

slides.title: Real sign-in and permissions
slides.body: Proper authentication, role-based access and secrets kept out of the code, in place of anyone being able to sign in.

slides.title: The paths a demo never takes
slides.body: Background jobs, queues and error handling, tested under real load so the second user doesn't break it.

slides.title: The services it depends on
slides.body: Payments, sign-in providers, email and monitoring, each connected properly and hardened.

slides.title: A way to ship and roll back
slides.body: Automated deploys with monitoring, so a release is routine and a bad one can be undone.
